blocks.text: Forsskål, in Descript. Animall. p. 8, in his list of birds that stay at Alexandria, has, as received from an Arab hunter: „Vultur — Sákr“. What the medieval writers wrote about this same falcon has been carefully collected and explained by IO. GOTTL. SCHNEIDER on the Reliqua librorum Frideric. II. de arte venandi cum avibus, p. 90. 109. 185. 186.
Cf. IO. GOTTL. SCHNEIDER on the Reliqua librorum Friderici II. p. 65.
Compare Schneider on that passage; to him, however, in the place cited above, note 2, it seems doubtful whether the αἰσαλων [aisalōn] is the same bird as the smerillon.
